name: Create Lead
description: Create a lead in HubSpot associated with an existing contact. Set **Contact ID** (the contact to link) and put lead fields in **Object Properties** as HubSpot internal names. Example: Contact ID `12345`, Object Properties `{ "hs_lead_name": "Isla Nublar Opportunity" }`. Returns the created lead with its id. [See the documentation](https://developers.hubspot.com/beta-docs/guides/api/crm/objects/leads#create-leads)
